metadata.description: Get paid for the coding-agent turns you already run.

plugins.name: prmpt
plugins.description: Prints one clearly-labelled sponsored line at the end of a turn that genuinely matches an advertiser, and pays you 70% of the click price: USDC, cbBTC or ETH on Base, or SOL, TINY or XAUt0 on Solana. Most turns match nothing and print nothing.
